# Bounded change request

**Status:** proposed
**Current Task:** TASK-XXX-YY
**Affected requirement / contract:** not recorded

## Discovered mismatch

Describe supported evidence and why the existing plan cannot meet an observable requirement as written.

## Proposed correction

Identify exact scope and alternative, backwards compatibility, migrations, privacy/security effects and tests. State whether an owner-established direction is affected; do not make that change silently.

## Dependency impact

Show changes to predecessor/exit conditions and confirm no circular or forward-only blocker. Keep implementation within the current Epic when feasible; update the roadmap explicitly when not.

## Decision and validation

Record the responsible actor's decision, source revision and rerun evidence. Routine contract repairs and implementation selections follow existing authority; changes to owner-established directions require an explicit owner decision. Never close a gate by accepting an unverified assumption.
